title: The MALL is Open: Exploring Shared Caches and Latency in AMD CDNA 3 GPUs
problem: Memory hierarchy characteristics of AMD CDNA 3 GPUs are not fully understood, hindering optimization
motivation: GPU applications need detailed latency profiles across cache hierarchy to optimize memory access patterns
method: Fine-grained pointer-chasing microbenchmarks characterizing sL1, L2, MALL (Infinity Cache), and HBM latencies across configurations
key_novelty: Detailed latency characterization of AMD MALL (Memory Attached Last Level cache) and NUMA effects on CDNA 3 GPUs
contributions: Memory latency profiles for MI300A, MI300X, MI250X
MALL contention and TLB behavior analysis
1.42x latency improvement via NPS4 NUMA partitioning
